name: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, you help the Auberdine Village Council and night elf sentinels guard Darkshore's coastal roads from mad predators.
As a night elf druid, you watch Darkshore's wildlife closely. Jai'vhanel's sudden madness and aggression alarm anyone who cares for the forests.
As a hunter, you know Swordfeather as a fierce black owl near Darkshore's mountains. Her hunting has turned dangerously erratic.

faq.answer: Jai'vhanel, called Swordfeather, is a large owl with black feathers. Native to Darkshore's forests, she has grown hostile to travelers through madness.

aliases: why is there a bounty on jaivhanel
faq.answer: The Auberdine Village Council posted a bounty because Jai'vhanel has gone mad and attacks travelers on the main road near Auberdine, putting them in danger.
faq.q: Why is there a bounty on Jai'vhanel?

faq.answer: Jai'vhanel prowls north of the ruins of Ameth'Aran in Darkshore, near the base of the eastern mountains.
The Auberdine Village Council posted the bounty. It oversees Auberdine's safety and welfare, along with that of the surrounding roads.
faq.q: Who posted the bounty on Jai'vhanel?

aliases: where to turn in jaivhanel feather
faq.answer: Bring one of Jai'vhanel's black feathers to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine as proof of the kill.
faq.q: Who collects the reward for Jai'vhanel?

aliases: what is proof of death for jaivhanel
faq.answer: One of Jai'vhanel's black feathers proves she has been slain.
faq.q: What proof is needed to claim the bounty?

sections.body: On Darkshore's coastal roads near Auberdine, travelers face danger from a mad owl. Jai'vhanel, known locally as Swordfeather, has turned on those who pass. She ambushes travelers and couriers near the settlement, leaving the roads unsafe.
sections.title: A Threat on the Road

sections.body: The Auberdine Village Council offers a bounty to make the roads safer. Jai'vhanel hunts north of the ruins of Ameth'Aran, along the mountain base. Bring one of her black feathers to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine as proof of the kill and to claim the reward.
sections.title: The Council's Bounty

summary: Near Auberdine, Jai'vhanel ambushes travelers on the coastal roads. The Auberdine Village Council has set a bounty for her death near the ruins of Ameth'Aran, with proof to be brought to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea.
